correctness.rationale: At the exact quartic over Q(a,b,c), all sixteen listed points satisfy F and its gradient and have nonzero Hessian determinants. The primary source proves exhaustiveness; a separate case argument is reconstructed in RESULT.md. Three exact rational-square identities reduce eight radicals to A,B,C,D,E. The valuation matrix in six distinct irreducible factors a,b,c,b-a,c-b,c-a has binary rank five, proving Galois degree 32, and the four radicand pairs each have rank two, proving exactly four degree-four closed points. The stand-alone exact checker verifies symbolic identities via rational specializations and independent F2 rank, without claiming these samples prove generic independence.

value.rationale: The rationality fields of all singularities are intrinsic arithmetic invariants of this newly parameterized sixteen-nodal quartic, needed to know over which base-field extension all exceptional curves of the minimal resolution separate. The four known planar sets conceal three nonobvious cross-packet dependencies: the splitting degree is 32 rather than the a priori 256 from eight radicals. A complete finite-etale/Galois classification over the natural function field is mathematically motivated by arithmetic resolution and descent, not an arbitrary parameter slice or just a numerical count.
